tei:div.tei:p: (1)rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag bla gdod ma'i mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ dong khrid nyam tshul phyi kun slong la/ sngags kyi smon sems ni/ bdag nang mtha' yas sogs lha sems ye shes su bskyed pa zhes/ rang bzhin gyi gzung 'jin 'khrul sems rang gnas kyi ye shes rang rig dpal chen blal ma'i dbyings su grol bar 'dod pa'i thugs bskyed dang*/ sngags spyi dang*/ khyad par nang rgyud sde gsum dag snang gi rnam pa yin pas phun sum tshogs pa lnga gsal btab nas/ yin grol thams cad sangs rgyas kyi mjad pa'i rjes 'gro dgon pas/ kun spyod kyang spang blang ma 'jol bar gsalal 'chal/ gang gsal bar bya ba'i chon la/ ston pas gdul bya'i khams dbang dang mthun pa'i bsam gyi mi khyab par gsung kyang bsdu na 'jin pa'i theg pa dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i theg pa gnyis su bsdu/ 'jig 'das la che chung gnyis su yod/ theg pa chen po ma rgyu lam byed mtshan nyid theg pa dang 'a lam byed rdo rje theg pa gnyis yod/ dong rgyu lam byedamacham nyid theg pas ni/ 'grub sku gnyis kyi sku gnyis tshogs gnyis lam du byed pa dang*/ chon spyi dang rang gi mchams nyid gtam la phan nas ring lam bskal pa'i mthar sangs rgyas thob/ de'i gang tsham bka' tha dom du gdod pas nyer lam gyi bde gshegs snying po rgyu dang*/ tshogs gnyis lha gcig byed rgyu byed nas sangs rgyas thob/ sngags kyi mthar thug gi 'grub sku gnyis kyi rnams dang lha nas bskyed rjogs gnyis kyi lam du byed pa yin/ rnam pa lam byed de'ang sol ba gser 'jis ltar blos gro btags pa ma yin par/ gzhi 'bras kyi bzhugs tshul dang mthun par lam bsgom pa yin skabs kyis che lasu gcig gis sku na thob bo/ dom du gzhi lam 'grub pa'i dus thams cad na gnas tshul la gnas yul lugs chos sku dang*/

de'i rang rtsal gzugs sku ste sku gnyis la nam yang 'da' mi srid cing*/ de gsum gyi ngo bo dbyer mi phyed pas lho theg pa zhes bya'o/ rdo rje theg pa'i nang tsham nang rgyud ste gsum gyi thabs bskyed rims dang*/ thugs gi rjogs rim sa ba byed pa brgyud dang*/ rang lus dang gzhan lus la bstem pa'i thig le'i rdzogs rim byed pa ma byung dang*/ grom lam lta ba kho na gco bor byed pa gnyis med rgyud yin/ de'ang gsar ma ltar/ pha rgyud rim lnga/ ma rgyud chos drug gnyis med rgyud sbyor drug rnams yin kyang dom du bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka'i rwa ba las mi 'da' bas/ bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas shing*/ rogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams las/ thabs 'di rjogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ rkas kyi gdang bu skur gsungs/ zhes bskyed rjogags rim pa gnyis pa'i rim pa gnyis pa grol lam rjogs pa chen po dang phyag chen gnyis khab mi len te/ sngags kyi rim pa gnyis thabs chen yin pa'i gnad kyis sa sogs kyis phyag chen la dbang dang lus kyi byed bcing sogs mi 'dug pas mdo yin nam sngags yin/ mdo yin na che lus gcig gi sprol mi mthong la/ sngags yin na dbang dang thabs lam dgong gsungs/ de'i phyir de nyid kyi phyag rgya chen po ni/ dbang las skyes pa'i ye shes yin/ zhes gsungs so/ phyag chen mdo lung du khri zer ba la/ dbang dgos mi dgos gnyis ka sgrub med gsungs/ ma hā'i grol lam dang rjogs chen gnyis la'ang thabs bskyed rjogs gang yang mi dgos pa'i (2)phyir ma mdo yis no da gcig gi zugs mi 'grub/ sngags yin mo yod goms zer bas kham yi leg kyang*/ lags yul
